description_en: Adds users to a user group in a batch
description_zh: 将用户批量添加到用户组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost add-users-to-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id '１' --user-ids 1_,_2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddUsersToGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance to which the user group belongs.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要添加用户的用户组所在的堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance to which the user group belongs.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要添加用户的用户组所在的堡垒机实例的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group to which you want to add users.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要添加用户的用户组的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the users to add to the user group. This parameter is a JSON-formatted string that supports up to 100 user IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query user IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要添加到用户组的用户ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多支持设置100个用户ID，多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取用户ID
parameters.name: user_ids

UNEXPECTED: An unknown error occurred.

Check the request parameters and call the operation again.

Check whether the bastion host instance ID exists, whether the host exists, and whether the host ID is correct, and then call the operation again.

Code.description_zh:

OK：操作成功。
UNEXPECTED：未知错误。
INVALID_ARGUMENT：请求参数设置错误。

OBJECT_NOT_FOUND：操作的对象不存在。

请检查该堡垒机实例的ID是否存在，主机是否存在，主机ID是否填写正确，然后重新调用接口。
